question: Red-team/blue-team audit of the Kingmaker SEO enterprise contractor-site business model before the live Mabrey Roofing build: verify every load-bearing internal claim against external 2025-2026 evidence — the client-facing capture metric, the on-page/technical doctrine, Google algorithm assumptions, the highest-ROI DIY off-page levers, GEO/AIO optimization, and any guaranteed-failure pitfalls.
subQuestions: Is the client-facing metric '1-2% of an area's money-term searches become calls' (derived: 15% traffic capture site-only / 30% full-system, x 10% visitor-to-lead conversion) defensible against 2025-2026 organic CTR curves, map-pack vs organic click share, zero-click/AI-Overview click erosion, and home-services website conversion benchmarks? Where does it break?

Does a ~150-200 page service-x-city architecture with real-job-gated unique content build ranking topical authority for a local contractor in 2026 — and where exactly is Google's doorway-page / scaled-content-abuse enforcement line (documented manual actions, HCU suppressions) for service-area pages?

What did Google's 2025-2026 core updates and AI Overviews expansion actually change for LOCAL contractor SEO: do AI Overviews appear on local commercial money terms (roof replacement, custom home builders), at what rate, and with what measured click impact? What do post-update local ranking factor studies say?

Which technical doctrine claims hold in 2026: (a) SSR/SSG is non-negotiable because AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) don't render JavaScript; (b) structured data/schema is 'insurance' with real retrieval value; (c) Core Web Vitals/INP carry meaningful ranking weight; (d) website/on-page signals materially influence map-pack rankings ('the site wins the pack when all else is equal')?

What are the highest-ROI off-page levers a solo operator can execute himself in 2026 for a local contractor (GBP primary category, review velocity, citations, manufacturer certification links like GAF/Owens Corning, local sponsorships, digital PR, HARO successors) — ranked by effort-to-impact with evidence?

What do the 'Claude Code / AI agent backlink' tools and GitHub projects people discuss actually do (automated outreach, programmatic citations, directory submission, comment/parasite spam) — which if any are legitimate white-hat leverage vs link-spam risk that violates Google policies, and what measurable ROI evidence exists?

What GEO/AIO (generative engine optimization) tactics have MEASURED evidence of increasing citations/visibility in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity for local service businesses (answer-first blocks, statistics, quotable snippets, entity sameAs, Bing indexing for ChatGPT, GBP data feeds) — and is llms.txt still unsupported/refuted in 2026?

What are the guaranteed-failure pitfalls for this model: doorway manual-action risk at 150-200 pages, FTC review-gating enforcement (fines, rules), GBP suspension triggers, cross-client duplicate-template footprint risk when cloning one design system across many contractor clients, unrealistic time-to-rank expectations for a rebuilt domain (realistic months-to-traction), and NC-specific contractor marketing compliance?
checklist: 2025-2026 organic CTR curve by position + AI Overview click-loss studies (Pew, Ahrefs, seoClarity or equivalent)
map pack vs organic click share on local service queries
home-services / contractor website visitor-to-lead conversion benchmarks (5-10%? 10%+?)
Google doorway-page policy text + documented enforcement on service-area/city pages
scaled content abuse policy (March 2024+) enforcement examples
topical authority evidence for local/small sites
local ranking factors survey weights: GBP, reviews, on-page, links, citations, behavioral (pack vs local organic)
AI crawler JavaScript rendering capabilities: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended
llms.txt support status among major AI providers as of 2026
GEO tactics with measured visibility lift (Princeton GEO paper and successors)
AI Overviews presence rate on local commercial intent queries 2026
DIY contractor link sources: manufacturer certification profiles (dofollow status), chambers, sponsorships, suppliers
HARO successor landscape 2026 (Connectively shutdown, alternatives)
AI-agent backlink automation tools on GitHub: what they do, spam/policy risk
FTC review gating / fake review rule (2024 final rule) penalties and what a compliant review SOP looks like
GBP suspension triggers and reinstatement reality
realistic time-to-rank for new or rebuilt local contractor sites (months to meaningful traffic)
duplicate/template footprint risk across cloned client sites (same design system, different content)
review velocity + primary category as pack levers (evidence)
12-month ramp assumption for local SEO results
stopCondition: Each load-bearing internal claim has at least 2 independent external sources supporting or refuting it, with conflicts surfaced rather than averaged; every checklist subtopic covered or enumerated as a gap.

internalClaimLedger.capture-metric: 1-2% of money-term searches -> calls; T1 site-only 15% capture x 10% conv = 1.5%; T2 full system 30% x 10% = 3%; 6-month conservative ~0.75%; denominator = money-term/high-intent searches only
internalClaimLedger.two-tier: site+citations+reviews ~15% capture; full system + off-page ~30%; baseline = T1; 12-month ramp; never stack optimism
internalClaimLedger.conversion: 10% visitor->lead is the enterprise house conversion number; change one factor never both
internalClaimLedger.architecture: ~150-200 service x city pages, real-job-gated (anti-doorway: review/real-job-backed unique pages, delete-the-city-name test), NO service x town combo clone matrix
internalClaimLedger.site-wins-pack: the site wins the map pack when all else is equal (deeper site = tiebreaker); on-page ~19% / off-page ~71% directional heuristic
internalClaimLedger.technical: Next.js SSG/SSR non-negotiable for AI legibility; Cloudflare AI-crawler unblock; Bing bootstrap for ChatGPT; llms.txt REFUTED; schema = insurance; word-level heading animation fragments for crawler-readable rendered text
internalClaimLedger.off-page: primary GBP category = #1 pack lever; review VELOCITY = fastest lever; GBP link -> dedicated landing page; geo-grid SoLV = the proof metric; NEVER PBNs
internalClaimLedger.geo-aio: AI-legibility QA: static + rendered innerText + AI extraction must all pass; .seo-answer blocks; entity sameAs; organic regional dominance = the engine, pack = ~5-7mi near-default byproduct
internalClaimLedger.competitor-ceiling: any pack projection computed from the same Local Falcon scan: leader coverage = the bound; project 'new market leader' not blue-sky
internalClaimLedger.mabrey-context: Durham NC roofer, $1.8M/yr shop, fragmented market (leader 11/49 top-3 at 58 reviews), SoLV 6.1% baseline, mabreyroofing.com rebuild 150-200 URLs, custom-home expansion pool ~1,130/mo money-terms Wake+Durham+Orange
